obligations.source_text: Visual priority: shoulders/upper torso, waist, crotch, both thighs/short hems, and cycling context must remain inspectable in the same frame.

bindings.fitted_two_leg_cycling_shorts_phrase: fitted cycling shorts form two coherent thigh-length leg openings
bindings.short_to_upper_bib_continuity_phrase: the cycling shorts continue upward into one upper bib torso section
bindings.two_shoulder_straps_phrase: two garment-owned bib straps continue over the shoulders
bindings.saddle_pad_or_explicit_cycling_context_p: an anatomically placed saddle-pad region or explicit bicycle-riding context remains visible
bindings.suspenders_unitard_overall_confound_cont: the garment must remain a purpose-built bib-short system
